actions.action: Explore scene-and-state paths with explicit limits
actions.mechanism: Track scene identifiers together with variable values so revisits with changed state remain distinct.
actions.implementation: Declare starting states, transition semantics, and depth, state-count, and time limits. Store predecessor choices and report why exploration stopped.
actions.check: A reachable scene includes a replayable witness; an unvisited scene after cutoff says “not explored within limit,” never “proven unreachable.”
actions.risk: Large state spaces require limits and can leave many scenes unresolved.

actions.action: Prove unreachable scenes separately from bounded exploration
actions.mechanism: Exhaustive finite-state exploration or sound overapproximation can establish unreachability without confusing missing evidence with proof.
actions.implementation: Add a proof pass for supported conditions and updates. Model unsupported code conservatively; label unresolved results unknown and attach proof assumptions.
actions.check: An unreachable warning exposes the declared starts and an inspectable exclusion certificate; unsupported behavior cannot silently strengthen the conclusion.
actions.risk: Conservative models can prevent proofs even when scenes are genuinely unreachable.

actions.action: Detect traps using state-aware closed regions
actions.mechanism: A reachable closed region without an accepted ending traps players; a scene-level cycle alone proves nothing.
actions.implementation: Find closed strongly connected components in a complete supported state graph. Show an entry path, repeating choices, and why every outward choice is disabled.
actions.check: A counter incrementing from zero exits on visit three without a trap warning; an impossible exit produces a trap certificate.
actions.risk: Incomplete exploration cannot establish closure; player-selectable repetition is not necessarily a trap.

actions.action: Replay warnings directly in the story editor
actions.mechanism: Stepwise execution makes warning evidence inspectable through the same choices and variables the writer edits.
actions.implementation: Provide a replay panel showing each scene, selected choice, condition evaluation, and before-and-after state. Link failed transitions to their expressions.
actions.check: Replaying a stored witness reproduces its final state; changed story versions mark old evidence stale rather than presenting it as current.
actions.risk: Replay diverges unless analyzer and player share transition semantics.

actions.action: Explain blocked scenes through backward conditions
actions.mechanism: Backward propagation identifies requirements for reaching a target and contradictions that prevent particular routes.
actions.implementation: Let writers select a scene, propagate its entry requirements backward through updates, and display conflicting conditions with source links.
actions.check: For a route requiring both flag=true and flag=false without an intervening update, show both conflicting choices; leave alternate routes separately classified.
actions.risk: A contradiction on one route does not prove the entire scene unreachable.

actions.mechanism: Exceptions attach intent to specific findings rather than silencing every warning around a scene or loop.
actions.implementation: Store warning type, affected choices or scene, relevant state predicate, rationale, and dependency fingerprint. Keep accepted findings visible in an exceptions view.
actions.check: Accepting a deliberate loop leaves an unrelated unreachable-scene warning active; changing its exit condition requests renewed review.
actions.risk: Broad predicates can hide accidental cases; preview the exact matched findings.

actions.action: Turn important paths into executable story contracts
actions.mechanism: Writer-defined expectations catch regressions independently of whether the analyzer discovers the same warning again.
actions.implementation: Save starting states and assertions such as “this ending remains reachable” or “this loop exits on visit three.” Run them after relevant edits.
actions.check: Include fixtures for three-visit escape and impossible escape; altering the counter update must fail the appropriate contract with evidence.
actions.risk: Bounded or unsupported checks must report inconclusive, not a passing contract.

actions.action: Use playtest traces to challenge the model
actions.mechanism: Observed executions supply concrete reachability witnesses and reveal differences between modeled and actual story behavior.
actions.implementation: Capture versioned scenes, choices, and state changes during opt-in playtests. Replay imported traces and compare every transition against analyzer semantics.
actions.check: A trace reaching a supposedly unreachable scene raises a model-mismatch error; scenes absent from all traces remain unproven, not unreachable.
actions.risk: External effects and sensitive state require controlled recording and explicit handling.
